bullets: Last week vs the plan: the bull path played out. Monday tagged 7305–09 (7313.25) and sold; Wednesday's data flush to 6982.50 held 6982–93 and reversed; Friday closed back above 7305–09 at 7308.25. The bear path to 6897 never triggered.

Friday close: SPX 7297.49 (+1.60%), SPY 728.32, QQQ 650.99 (+2.69%), NDX 26,726.39, VIX 23.81, ES 7308.25 (regular session 7222.75 at 7:05 AM PT to 7320.75 into the close). Week: SPX +5.60%, QQQ +6.99%.

ES levels plan: the Wednesday failed-breakdown long reached its 7309 backtest target; Friday's dip to 7250 support was swept and reclaimed. Next: 7309, 7334, 7362–65, then 7405, the next major gateway. The structure is read as healthy for bulls while 7305–09 holds.
Auction read (Thu/Fri plan): 7215 was the pivot — above it targets were 7240 / 7278 / 7314, all reached Friday. VIX under 26.32 with ES over 7314 was the strength confirmation; VIX closed 23.81.

Positioning (Fri close, free chains): every all-dates board negative gamma. Monday SPX: call wall 7300, put wall 7275, flip ≈ 7340. SPY Monday: call wall and biggest strike 730, put wall 724, flip ≈ 737.3. QQQ Monday: call 650, put 640, flip ≈ 651.7. SPX all-dates biggest strike 7400, call wall 7600.
Flow: calls led all session — about +$367M net across the market; SPY near-dated put/call 0.46. Notable: SPX Feb 6225 puts $11.2M (about 3× open interest), AAPL Feb '27 400 calls $3.9M on one print.

Post-market SPY read: Monday's close vs SPY's 10-month average is the month-end test; 727 is flagged as Monday's big level and month-end window dressing argued against pressing shorts before Monday's close.

Week ahead: Mon Chicago PMI 6:45 AM PT · Tue ISM manufacturing and JOLTS 7:00 AM PT · Wed ADP 5:15 AM PT · Thu claims 5:30 AM PT and ISM services 7:00 AM PT · Fri jobs report 5:30 AM PT. FOMC Dec 8–9.
